notes.title: v0.80 of Doodle WHAT?! Now released!
notes.content: Connection method with Twitch has been revamped. You're no longer required to enter password directly into Doodle WHAT?! Instead, you'll be brought to Twitch page (embedded within app) where you’ll authorize link to your account. This also fixes the two-step verification issue.
